svg.aria-label: AI Engineer Intern at ITR VN · Ho Chi Minh City. Implemented PPG2BP-Net for cuffless blood pressure (SBP MAE 9.76 ± 8.99 mmHg, DBP MAE 5.25 ± 5.26 mmHg), built MIMIC-III data pipelines, cut processing latency about 40% with NumPy vectorisation, and built an STM32 + MAX30102 Bluetooth prototype.
